script.action: Total darkness with faint wind sound. Overhead spotlight reveals Devi suspended mid-air holding a closed black umbrella.
Devi descends slowly and smoothly from a solid industrial ladder. Background models stand far back in shadows with minimal movement.
Devi steps firmly onto a solid runway floor. Camera remains stable and cinematic.
Devi opens the large black umbrella. Rain begins falling only around her, with realistic physics. Background models remain dry.

hook: What if you could control the atmosphere?
caption: Mastering the elements in a world of luxury.
